# Curated Pi-hole blocklist

> A daily, reproducible Pi-hole v6 DNS blocklist built from six popular maintained sources and reduced by exact and parent-domain semantic deduplication.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/pihole-curated-blocklist
Subscription URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iamwaqargulzar/pihole-curated-blocklist/main/dist/blocklist.txt
License: GPL-3.0; upstream data retains its own attribution and license terms.

## Primary documentation

- [README](https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/pihole-curated-blocklist/blob/main/README.md): installation, current measured result, safeguards, limitations and FAQ.
- [Methodology](https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/pihole-curated-blocklist/blob/main/docs/methodology.md): parser, normalization, semantic deduplication and exception behavior.
- [Source evaluation](https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/pihole-curated-blocklist/blob/main/docs/source-evaluation.md): dated comparison, selection rationale, alternatives and primary references.
- [Build statistics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iamwaqargulzar/pihole-curated-blocklist/main/dist/stats.json): machine-readable current counts, source URLs and payload hashes.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/iamwaqargulzar/pihole-curated-blocklist/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): false-positive and missed-domain evidence requirements.

## Key facts

- First measured build: 490,378 final block rules from 734,206 source block rules on 11 September 2026.
- Sources: HaGeZi Pro mini, HaGeZi TIF mini, HaGeZi DoH-only, oisd big, AdGuard DNS Filter and StevenBlack hosts.
- Scope: advertising, tracking, telemetry, phishing, malware, scams and known DoH endpoints.
- Excluded policy categories: adult content, gambling, piracy and blanket social-media blocking.
- Limitation: DNS filtering cannot reliably block YouTube ads, same-origin ads, VPN traffic, direct IP traffic or every unknown encrypted-DNS endpoint.
